alignments.note: The ASV gives 'prayer' no determiner, so the article has no English 'the' to anchor and the dative's case preposition stays with the noun (rules 21 and 23).
Determinerless dative: 'in prayer' is one unit headed on the noun (rule 21).
προσκαρτερέω rendered by the two-word verb expression 'Continue stedfastly'; the verb word glosses the lexeme and takes the head (rule 17).
Preposition fused with its governed pronoun into a single 'there-' word: 'there-' answers to αὐτῇ and '-in' to ἐν, so this is one aligned unit headed on the pronominal (rule 81).

review_notes: ἐν αὐτῇ → 'therein' is read under rule 81 as aligned rather than noncompositional, both elements being spelt in the single word.
